title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (BSC/RNC), OSS and Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.


Responsibilities:

  • (Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
  • Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
  • Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
  • Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
  • Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.



Technical Requirements:

  • Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.


Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Engineering Manager - AI Agents & Platform
description:
Engineering Manager - Agents

$ - $ + equity

Remote


This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role.

If you don’t actively use AI tools to build, test and ship software, this won’t be a fit.

If you do....keep reading.

You’ll still ship.

title: Caixa
description:
Operador de Caixa (vaga temporária 5x2 em loja de Shopping)


Venha crescer com a Linus!


A Linus é uma marca que tem como propósito tornar o bem-estar um estilo de vida , por meio de escolhas práticas e conscientes. Por isso, se você quer fazer parte de um amanhã mais sustentável - ambiental, social e financeiramente - questionando o status-quo de maneira colaborativa e ética, esta vaga é para você.


o que você vai fazer


1) Registro de vendas e trocas : escanear códigos de barras, inserir preços manualmente ou utilizar sistemas eletrônicos para registrar os produtos adquiridos ou devolvidos pelos clientes.


2) Processamento de pagamentos : receber pagamentos em dinheiro, cartões de crédito/débito, cheques ou outros métodos, calcular o troco e emitir comprovantes de pagamento.


3) Atendimento ao cliente : atender aos clientes com cordialidade, responder dúvidas sobre produtos, preços e promoções, e garantir uma experiência de compra agradável fisicamente e também no canal digital (WhatsApp).


4) Gestão de caixa : abrir e fechar o caixa, conferir valores para evitar inconsistências, manter o local de trabalho organizado e realizar a manutenção básica do equipamento.


5) Emissão de documentos fiscais : emitir notas fiscais ou recibos para os clientes.


6) Gestão de estoque e prevenção de perdas : auxiliar na organização do estoque e na identificação de produtos com problemas, contribuindo para a prevenção de perdas.


7) Comunicação e trabalho em equipe : manter uma comunicação clara com os clientes e com a equipe, buscando soluções para eventuais problemas e colaborando com outras tarefas da loja, quando necessário.



do que você precisa para conquistar a vaga


  • Responsabilidade e proatividade;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Gostar de moda;
  • Gostar de lidar com pessoas;
  • Comprometimento com as suas atividades, horários e com a empresa;
  • Ter experiência com atendimento ao cliente pode ser um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade.
  • Formação: ensino superior completo com formação em Administração/Gestão de Negócios/Marketing/áreas correlatas E/OU cursos em Vendas e Gestão de Equipes/Capacitação em Vendas.
  • Liderança ou gestão de equipes serão considerados diferenciais.
  • Conhecimento em Iglu, Shopify serão considerados diferenciais.



o que oferecemos


  • Vale-refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
  • Create, review, and automate processes using PowerShell to increase efficiency and operational control.
  • Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, system migrations, and upgrades.
  • Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD, testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento.

- Boa comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

A sua missão não é \"reinventar a roda\" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.


Responsabilidades:


1. Arquitetura e Orquestração

  • Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
  • Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;
  • Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.


2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)

  • Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando NestJS e TypeScript;
  • Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;
  • Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.


3. Produtividade aumentada por IA

  • Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.
  • Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.


4. Liderança e Mentoria

  • Visão técnica: fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de \"Build vs buy\" relacionadas com componentes de IA;
  • Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI/CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência: Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Backend: Forte proficiência em Node.js e TypeScript (experiência com NestJS é uma vantagem significativa);
  • Frontend: Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;
  • Bases de dados: Conhecimento especializado em SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou similar);
  • Cloud & DevOps: Experiência com AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker e pipelines CI/CD modernos;
  • Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.


Competências Essenciais

  • Mentalidade generalista: capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico \"apenas de IA\";
  • Pensamento arquitetônico: capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;
  • Orientado para resultados: focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.


Desejável/ Plus

  • Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;
  • Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;
  • Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);
  • Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

Job Title: Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Azure Fabric

Location: Remote / Flexible

Experience: 12+ years in data engineering and analytics solutions

Role Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks, Azure Fabric, and related cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in big data, data engineering, cloud computing, and SQL, and will provide technical leadership to ensure scalable, high-performance data solutions aligned with business needs.

Essential Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark) and frameworks such as PySpark.
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices and data governance.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Familiarity with Spark Streaming for real-time data processing.
  • Experience with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Leadership and mentoring abilities to guide a team of data engineers effectively.
  • Proactive and collaborative approach to cross-functional teamwork.

Job Description

  • Missão do Cargo:

Responsável por coordenar e garantir o cumprimento das obrigações principais e acessórias relacionadas aos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI e ISS), assegurando a conformidade tributária da empresa de forma tempestiva e eficiente. Atua como referência técnica e estratégica na área fiscal, promovendo alinhamento entre as operações e a legislação vigente.


  • Principais responsabilidades:


Técnicas:

  • Coordenar as atividades da área fiscal/tributária, com foco nos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI e ISS).
  • Garantir a correta apuração dos tributos e escrituração fiscal de notas fiscais de entradas (matéria-prima, consumo e serviços) dentro do período de competência.
  • Monitorar créditos e débitos registrados nos livros fiscais, assegurando controle e revisão para suportar novas operações de negócio.
  • Realizar conciliações das contas patrimoniais relacionadas aos impostos indiretos, identificando e explicando variações entre balancetes e apurações.
  • Realizar pesquisas legislativas e jurisprudenciais com o time consultivo, visando identificar riscos e oportunidades de planejamento tributário.
  • Acompanhar prazos de vencimento e renovação de Regimes Especiais, Certidões Negativas e DEC Municipal.
  • Atender auditorias internas e externas, bem como fiscalizações dos órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais, fornecendo informações e documentos necessários.
  • Alinhar fluxos de processos com áreas internas para garantir o correto envio e registro de documentos fiscais.
  • Participar de projetos sistêmicos (ex.: S4, KSRM, Move2, Transportation), identificando gaps e propondo melhorias para o correto registro fiscal.


Pessoas:

  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares aproximadamente 12 profissionais;

  • Promover o engajamento da equipe para garantir entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Financial Virtual Assistant with AI Experience
description:

  • Daily cost monitoring
  • Job profitability
  • Vendor balances
  • Subcontractor debts

  • QUERY()

  • FILTER()

Build automations that reduce manual work, such as:

  • Wells Fargo → Google Sheets transaction import

  • JobTread → Sheets → Slack alerts
  • Automated job cost reports sent daily
  • AI categorization of transactions
  • AI forecasting for cash flow and profit

Tools you’ll use:

  • ChatGPT

  • Build monthly + quarterly profit forecasts

  • Burn rate
  • Labor efficiency

Requirements Technical Skills
  • 3+ years bookkeeping experience

Mindset & Qualities
  • Highly organized and accurate

  • Proactive problem solver

Compensation
  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Performance incentives
  • Long-term, stable position
  • Work directly with U.S. CEO and leadership
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior AI-CFO role
How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Examples of dashboards you’ve built

description:

title: Analista Sr. de Qualidade de Projetos

  • Excelente organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Boa comunicação escrita em português
  • Familiaridade com Excel (uso frequente de planilhas, filtros, organização de dados)

  • Perfil responsável, MÉTODICO e confiável para lidar com dados

4 a 8 horas por dia, segunda a sexta.

Liberdade de horário de trabalho, desde que as tarefas sejam cumpridas no cronograma.

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we’re in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.

Estamos em busca de um(a) FinOps Cloud que tenha olhar analítico e proatividade para gerenciar e otimizar custos relacionados à infraestrutura em nuvem. Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Conhecimento básico em Cloud Computing para extração e análise de custos.

In-office in Rio de Janeiro

About the Project

A leading content creation & marketing platform for K-12 athletic departments, schools, and districts in the U.S., trusted by thousands of customers across all 50 states. One of the key products is interactive touchscreen displays that showcase a school’s awards, records, and history.


About the Role

As a Launch Specialist, you will be the first to welcome a newly signed school or athletic department to Touch and guide them through a smooth, high-quality launch. You’ll manage multiple customer accounts at different onboarding stages, collect required assets, confirm setup details, and build much of the initial Touch site yourself (pages, content, layouts) to ensure the display is accurate, visually polished, and ready for launch—then support a seamless handoff to Customer Success.


Requirements

- Ability to effectively manage multiple customer accounts, each at different stages of the onboarding journey;

- Growth mindset: you’re a lifelong learner who’s committed to continuous professional growth and development;

- Solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership; you can identify issues and take appropriate action;

- Hunger for a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, change is standard, and flexibility is a must;

- Strong design sense with the ability to create clean, organized, and visually polished Touch sites;

- Excellent English fluency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication (C1/C2 proficiency preferred);

- Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

- Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be in-office five days per week.


Responsibilities

- Welcome newly signed schools or athletic departments to Touch and guide customers through a smooth, high-quality launch;

- Manage a portfolio of partners in different stages of the onboarding journey; collect required assets and confirm setup details;

- Build much of the initial Touch site: structuring pages, organizing content, configuring layouts, and ensuring accuracy and completeness;

- Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve questions, remove blockers, and keep launches moving forward on schedule;

- Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound emails, Zoom meetings, and calls; answer questions and set timelines;

- Log all activity in Salesforce and ensure a seamless handoff to the Customer Success team after a successful launch.


We offer

- Mentorship and career growth: Learn directly from experienced B2B SaaS leaders, with a clear path for professional development across a variety of roles in support, sales, and customer success;

- Ownership and impact: Take responsibility for real outcomes and see your work make a difference for thousands of organizations;

- Startup experience: Gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-growing SaaS company operates;

- International opportunity: Work from Brazil, with a global team, selling into the U.S. market;

- Time off includes ~13 standard, annual US holidays, 15 business days of PTO for the first year, 18 for year two, and 21 for every year after;

- In-office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (five days per week).

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Vaga: Key Account Manager – THE OG



Local: Híbrido – Atuação regional em São Paulo com visitas presenciais a clientes.

Segmento: Lifestyle | Headshops | Distribuidoras



Sobre a THE OG


A THE OG é uma marca nacional de lifestyle que conecta autenticidade, estética e qualidade em tudo o que faz. Atuamos nos segmentos de produtos para headshops, streetwear e eventos, entregando mais do que produtos: vendemos originalidade e conexão real com o público.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Key Account Manager com experiência no setor, para fortalecer nossa presença junto a distribuidoras e parceiros estratégicos em todo o país.



Responsabilidades


- Gerir e expandir a carteira de grandes contas, garantindo alto nível de relacionamento e fidelização;

- Prospectar novosparceiros e distribuidores, desenvolvendo oportunidades comerciais sustentáveis;

- Negociar contratos, metas e condições comerciais com foco em rentabilidade e crescimento;

- Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e elaborar relatórios estratégicos;

- Atuar em sinergia com as áreas de Marketing, Operações e Trade, garantindo execução de campanhas e ativações nos pontos de venda;

- Realizar visitaspresenciais periódicas para acompanhamento de performance e oportunidades no campo.



Requisitos


- Experiência comprovada em Key Account, Executivo de Contas ou Vendas B2B;

- Sólida habilidade em negociação, gestão de relacionamento e estratégia comercial;

- Perfil autônomo,proativo e orientado a resultados;

- Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas a clientes;

- CNH e veículo próprio (diferencial).



Diferenciais


- Conhecimento sobre o universo cannabis lifestyle, cultura urbana e streetwear;

- Histórico de crescimento comprovado de contas e expansão de mercado no setor de headshops, distribuidoras ou consumo lifestyle;

- Rede de contatosconsolidada no setor.



O que oferecemos


- Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo;

- Liberdade para implementar ideias e estratégias;

- Remuneração compatível com o mercado + bônus por performance;

- Possibilidade real de crescimento e liderança comercial.

title: Data Engineer Gcp
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are Seeking a "Data Engineer" to build, optimize, and maintain the modern data platform within a cloud environment.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Work experience on relational l & non-relational databases platform
  • Design, build, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines for batch and real-time processing, from ingestion to final consumption.
  • Construct and manage the data lake infrastructure (multi-cloud), ensuring governance, security, and scalability.
  • Administer and optimize various database management systems (DBMS) , including relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Implement real-time data stream processing solutions using technologies like Apache Kafka or similar.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, observability, and reliability through testing, monitoring, and pipeline versioning.
  • Implement and enforce data security and privacy policies.
  • Automate repetitive data engineering and management tasks, applying DevOps and CI/CD principles.
  • Proven experience in data engineering, focusing on both batch and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data platforms and orchestration tools (e.G., Apache Spark, Airflow, Databricks).
  • Deep knowledge of GCP cloud environments and data-related services.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with both relational and non-relational databases.
  • Experience with data streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka or managed cloud services.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.G., Terraform, Ansible) is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.



What can you expect from us?


- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. As an IB World School, we are looking for an educator who can seamlessly integrate maker-centered learning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP) curriculum. Working closely with classroom teachers and specialists, this educator will design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based projects that nurture innovation, design thinking, a maker mindset, and strong foundations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) for students from Kindergarten to Grade 5.

The ideal candidate is:

  • Holds a Bachelor’s degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
  • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description:
1. About Us

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. Guided by our core belief—“We help people eat better, live better” —we’re bringing innovation to the global stage and building a better future for consumers and partners alike.


2. Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing and developing assigned accounts, supporting medium-sized chain brands to strengthen cooperation with the platform through brand marketing and promotional activities, contributing to the growth of transaction volume;
    executing the company’ssales strategy and supporting the achievement of sales targets;
  • Understand the business operations of the brands under responsibility based on their industry characteristics, and assist in developing and implementing food delivery solutions through basic business data analysis;
  • Maintain effective communication with the platform’s delivery team, acting as a liaison between the delivery team and assigned brands to help improve the overall delivery service experience;
  • Actively collect first-hand marketing information, user feedback, and local market insights, and provide practical and actionable suggestions to support business improvements.

3. Basic Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development in the food, restaurant, or consumer goods industry is preferred;
  • Good negotiation and market development skills, strong goal orientation, customer-focused mindset, and willingness to take on challenges;
  • Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in office software applications;
    experience working withreports and charts is required;
  • High level of integrity, responsibility, resilience, and teamwork;
    proactive and passionate about work;
  • English is mandatory.


4. Why Join Us?

Be part of the global expansion of Meituan’s food delivery revolution. At Keeta, you’ll experience firsthand the fast-paced growth and transformation of a cutting-edge industry. Join a diverse, world-class team that encourages bold thinking and global collaboration. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

Queremos aumentar ainda mais a diversidade das nossas pessoas, pois entendemos que essa é a chave para a inovação. Por isso, incentivamos que mulheres, pessoas da comunidade LGBTQIAPN+, indígenas, afrodescendentes, pessoas com deficiência, maiores de 50 anos se candidatem as nossas vagas. Celebramos a diversidade e o nosso compromisso é criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os colaboradores.

  • Realizar rondas durante todo o período, observando as condições de infraestrutura das dependências do site, por exemplo: sistema de ar condicionado, vazamentos e infiltrações, sistema de iluminação, check-list e OSs preventivas ou corretivas.

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Descrição do perfil

Responsável por assegurar o desenvolvimento e a gestão das infraestruturas técnicas necessárias para as atividades de cobrança, controlando o processo de cobrança, analisando periodicamente as contas para identificar aquelas que podem requerer procedimentos de cobrança especiais e atuando também nos processos de governança que envolvem a cadeia de cobrança.

Principais atividades

  • Controlar todos os processos da cadeia de Cobrança, com objetivo de garantir a aderência as regras de negócio implementadas e o monitoramento fim a fim de todas as etapas da régua de cobrança;
  • Gerenciar as bases faturadas Vs. Ações de cobrança, mapeando os principais ofensores/oportunidades garantindo a qualidade;
  • Realizar auditorias sobre todas as ações da régua de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar os principais ofensores em toda cadeia de cobrança e assim atuar junto a TI na solução das inconsistências;
  • Controlar o processo de No Dunning (isenção de cobrança), com o objetivo de garantir a governança desta carteira e seus respectivos motivos, por meio de relatórios e processos de auditoria;
  • Realizar controles SOX da cadeia de Cobrança;
  • Analisar reclamações ANATEL, sobre as ações de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar as oportunidades sobre os processos sistêmico da cadeia, garantindo a melhoria contínua e redução do índice de reclamações de Cobrança na ANATEL;
  • Controlar todo processo de negativação, tendo interação direta com os fornecedores de Bureaus de Crédito;
  • Desenvolver relatórios que possibilitem o melhor controle da cadeia de cobrança;
  • Participar de War Room junto a TI, para tratar os temas relacionados a cadeia de cobrança;
  • Automatizar processos e Relatórios;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas;
  • Segmentar listas de contato por perfil e objetivos das ações multicanal;
  • Realizar análises sobre o desempenho nos diferentes canais de contato de cobrança;
  • Monitoramento de métricas como taxa de abertura, cliques, conversões e rejeições;
  • Gerar insights com base nos dados coletados para melhoria contínua;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios periódicos para acompanhamento de performance.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Power BI e SQL (preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform/BigQuery);
  • Obrigatório Graduação Completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

title: Analista De Seguros Júnior -Vaga Exclusiva Para Pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.


Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência na comercialização de produtos financeiros e assessoria direta com cliente final;
  • Necessário ter a certificação CPA-20 ou CEA (Certificação CFP será um diferencial);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro ou possuir disponibilidade para mudanças;

  5. Proposta
  6. Contratação


Venha ser Genial você também!

É buscar a excelência, é fazer acontecer. É ser talentoso, inteligente, curioso e aceitar qualquer desafio. É se apresentar e defender as suas ideias. É colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar e ser apaixonado pelo que faz.


Por que a Genial?

Porque somos digitais, mas também somos humanos. Se você, assim como nós, acredita que investimento não é sinônimo de terno e gravata, queremos conhecer você!


Sobre Nós

A empresa que investe em você! Descomplicamos o mercado financeiro para que nossos clientes consigam tomar boas decisões na hora de investir.


Nossos Valores

Buscar os melhores resultados para os clientes;

Colocar excelência em tudo que fazemos;

Ser uma empresa responsável, transparente e sustentável;

Inovar para inspirar;

Ser apaixonado pelo que faz;

Aprender e melhorar sempre.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , DevOps Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement .
  • Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub , GitHub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills;
    fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: International Buyer
description:
General Description


The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.


Detailed Description


Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.G., FAA, EASA).


Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.


Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.


Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.


Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.


Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.


Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.


Qualification Minimum Requirements


Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage


Educational:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English


Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)


Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Estagiário De Customer Support
description:
Sobre a DTX


A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.


Sobre o trabalho


Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de suporte ao cliente.

O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação de especialistas em atendimento ao cliente em unidades técnicas de MRO de trem de pouso.

O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de "job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de atendimento ao cliente "end-to-end" .


O estagiário de suporte ao cliente irá ajudar nossa equipe de atendimento ao cliente a garantir operações tranquilas e promover relacionamentos positivos com nossos clientes. Este estágio proporcionará uma valiosa experiência prática na indústria aeroespacial de MRO, particularmente na área de sistemas de trem de pouso. O estagiário apoiará as atividades diárias de atendimento ao cliente, ajudará na resolução de dúvidas dos clientes e contribuirá para o processo geral de satisfação do cliente.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar na resposta às perguntas dos clientes por telefone, e-mail ou chat, fornecendo informações relacionadas aos serviços de MRO do trem de pouso.
  • Coordenar com equipes internas, incluindo engenharia, operações e logística, para garantir a resolução oportuna das solicitações dos clientes.
  • Ajudar a manter registros precisos do cliente, garantindo que todas as interações sejam documentadas no sistema de CRM.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de cotações, cronogramas de serviços e relatórios para clientes.
  • Auxiliar no rastreamento e atualização dos pedidos dos clientes, garantindo a entrega pontual dos serviços.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de suporte ao cliente para garantir altos níveis de satisfação do cliente e acompanhar os problemas de serviço.
  • Participar de pesquisas de feedback do cliente e contribua para melhorar os processos de atendimento.
  • Ajudar em quaisquer tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao suporte ao cliente e entrada de dados.
  • Auxiliar na resolução de quaisquer problemas operacionais, incluindo atrasos ou discrepâncias de serviço, sob supervisão.

Competências a serem adquiridas:


Compreensão dos sistemas de trem de pouso:

  • Conhecimento básico dos componentes e funções dos sistemas de trem de pouso em aeronaves.
  • Familiaridade com práticas comuns de manutenção de trem de pouso, procedimentos de reparo e cronogramas de revisão.


Entrada de dados e gerenciamento de banco de dados:

  • Desenvolver habilidades na inserção e gerenciamento de grandes quantidades de dados técnicos, como solicitações de atendimento ao cliente, especificações de peças e relatórios de serviço.
  • Aprender a organizar e recuperar dados de forma eficiente para relatórios e análises.


Ferramentas de cotação e estimativa:

  • Ganhar exposição às ferramentas e processos usados para preparar cotações e estimativas de serviços, incluindo a compreensão de modelos de preços com base em custos de peças e horas de mão de obra.
  • Saber como ajudar na geração de estimativas de custos para reparos e revisões de trem de pouso.


Solução de problemas com problemas técnicos:

  • Desenvolver habilidades na identificação e análise de problemas técnicos relatados pelos clientes, como problemas com o desempenho do trem de pouso.
  • Aprender a coordenar com engenheiros e equipes técnicas para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas com eficiência.


Requisitos e informações da vaga:

  • O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em disciplina relevante.
  • A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
  • Duração de 12 meses.
  • O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.

7) Comunicação e trabalho em equipe : manter uma comunicação clara com os clientes e com a equipe, buscando soluções para eventuais problemas e colaborando com outras tarefas da loja, quando necessário.

  • Desenvolver e implementar projetos de melhoria contínua utilizando metodologias como PDCA, Lean e Six Sigma.
  • Garantir a execução adequada de protocolos assistenciais, assegurando qualidade, segurança, humanização e conformidade legal.
  • Representar a instituição junto a órgãos reguladores, autoridades sanitárias e demais entidades externas, quando aplicável.
  • Definir, acompanhar e revisar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e metas estratégicas da área.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e análises consolidadas para apoio à tomada de decisão da alta liderança.

  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas internas, políticas de compliance, saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho.


Formação

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Administração Hospitalar, Enfermagem, Medicina ou áreas correlatas.

Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.

title: Médico Associado
description:
Vaga: Médico Associado (Investidor) – Novo Complexo Hospitalar


Localização: Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ

Tipo de Contrato: Associativo / PJ

Setor: Gestão Hospitalar e Investimentos em Saúde


Sobre o Projeto

Estamos selecionando profissionais de medicina para compor o quadro de associados de um novo empreendimento hospitalar de grande porte, estrategicamente localizado no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. O projeto visa atender à alta demanda reprimida da região através de uma estrutura moderna, financiada e gerida por meio de capital privado e ativos imobiliários.


Descrição da Oportunidade

Esta posição não se refere a um cargo celetista ou plantonista. Trata-se de uma oportunidade para o médico ingressar no negócio como Associado.

O selecionado fará a aquisição de cotas do empreendimento, garantindo participação nos resultados financeiros futuros sobre o ativo, sem a necessidade de dedicar horas de trabalho administrativo ou operacional.

Modelo de Atuação:

  • Investimento: Aquisição de cota patrimonial.
  • Gestão: A administração hospitalar será 100% profissionalizada;
    o associado não terá funções executivas ou poder de voto na operação diária, garantindo que sua participação seja um ativo financeiro e não uma carga de trabalho.
  • Retorno: Remuneração variável baseada na distribuição de lucros líquidos da operação hospitalar.


Responsabilidades do Associado
  • Integralizar o aporte financeiro referente à cota adquirida.
  • Manter conduta ética alinhada aos valores da instituição.
  • Acompanhar as assembleias de prestação de contas financeiras (sem caráter deliberativo operacional).


Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Medicina (Obrigatório) com CRM Ativo.
  • Especialidade: Indiferente (aceitamos generalistas e especialistas de todas as áreas).
  • Perfil Financeiro: Disponibilidade de capital para aporte inicial (investimento).
  • Visão: Interesse em diversificação de patrimônio dentro do setor de saúde.


Benefícios da Associação
  1. Lastro Real: Seu investimento é vinculado ao imóvel (tijolo) e à operação, oferecendo segurança patrimonial.
  2. Renda Passiva: Recebimento de dividendos proporcionais à cota, gerados pela operação do hospital.
  3. Sem "Dor de Cabeça": Sem responsabilidades trabalhistas, jurídicas ou administrativas sobre a gestão do hospital.
  4. Legado: Participação direta na viabilização de um marco na saúde do Rio de Janeiro.


Etapas do Processo
  1. Análise de credenciais médicas (CRM).
  2. Reunião Presencial com a Diretoria para apresentação do Business Plan , projeto arquitetônico e valores de cota.
  3. Formalização Contratual.
